validated_results.title: The role of 1,25(oh)2d3 and its analogs in proliferation and differentiation of squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck – literature review.
validated_results.reason: The paper is a literature review of 1,25(OH)2D3 effects in head and neck squamous carcinoma cell lines, not an original study of vitamin D and prostate cancer incidence.

validated_results.title: Integrative Approaches to Chemotherapy-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy.
validated_results.reason: The article is a review of complementary and integrative approaches to chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy that only mentions vitamin E prostate cancer risk in passing.

validated_results.title: Prostate Cancer: Biology, Incidence, Detection Methods, Treatment Methods, and Vaccines.
validated_results.reason: This is a narrative overview of prostate cancer biology, detection, and treatment with no original data on Western dietary pattern and incidence.

validated_results.title: Influence of Diet and Nutrition on Prostate Cancer.
validated_results.reason: The publication is a narrative review of diet and nutrition in prostate cancer and reports no original vitamin A incidence estimate.
